LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Mirror016.nodes.0.label: Mirror Echo
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Mirror016.nodes.0.descrip: Requires Mirror Summon learned from its augment. Retains the original summon count, lifetime, limits and recovery. Later nodes accept only primary damaging attacks by your active echoes, excluding drones, bears and relay projections. Echoes share their owner’s cooldowns.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Mirror016.nodes.1.label: Feint and Follow
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Mirror016.nodes.1.descrip: Your damaging ordinary hit marks the enemy for 4 seconds. One mark, created once per 6 seconds. A later damaging hit by your echo consumes it for 50 bonus damage. Your own attacks cannot consume it. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Mirror016.nodes.2.label: Reflected Cover
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Mirror016.nodes.2.descrip: Two damaging echo attacks on the same enemy, no more than 3 seconds apart, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 6 seconds. Changing targets resets the count. No ally means no shield. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Mirror016.nodes.3.label: Splintered Edge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Mirror016.nodes.3.descrip: After Feint and Follow deals its bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 6 seconds. Never hits the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Mirror016.nodes.4.label: Returning Echo
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Mirror016.nodes.4.descrip: After Feint and Follow deals its bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 6 seconds. Cannot restore missing parts or permanent scars. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Mirror016.nodes.5.label: Twin Reflection
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Mirror016.nodes.5.descrip: Two damaging echo attacks on the same enemy, no more than 3 seconds apart, also grant you a separate 1-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 6 seconds. Resolves independently of Reflected Cover. Base rewards: shield 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Mirror016.nodes.6.label: Aid Behind the Mirror
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Mirror016.nodes.6.descrip: Two damaging echo attacks on the same enemy, no more than 3 seconds apart, heal 20 base points on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 6 seconds. With no injured ally it does not heal you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.
